oppressive.name: Koalitionszwang

oppressive.name: Tunnelvision

criticalAssertions.name: Bestechungsskandal 2.0
criticalAssertions.claim: Can steal an enemy government card via W6+oligarch bonus; permanently flips board influence. At bp3 this can win a round on the spot.

criticalAssertions.name: Maulwurf
criticalAssertions.claim: Auto-targets weakest gov; often needs only W6≥2–3. After bp nerf to 3 still among strongest swing cards.

criticalAssertions.name: Oppositionsblockade
criticalAssertions.claim: Locks all opponent initiatives until EOT. With bp nerf to 3 still shuts a whole strategy pillar.

criticalAssertions.name: Parlament geschlossen
criticalAssertions.claim: Hard-locks further government plays for the round once ≥2 govs are down — freezes the win condition.

criticalAssertions.name: Partei-Offensive
criticalAssertions.claim: Deactivates strongest enemy gov for bp3 — direct score deletion with no dice.

criticalAssertions.name: Cyber-Attacke
criticalAssertions.claim: Destroys (not just deactivates) a Platform public — permanent resource denial.

criticalAssertions.name: Jeff Bezos
criticalAssertions.claim: Removes all other oligarchs from board on play — nukes entire oligarch engine for both sides asymmetrically.

criticalAssertions.name: Ai Weiwei
criticalAssertions.claim: Every initiative activation: +1 card +1 AP. Infinite tempo engine if left up.

criticalAssertions.name: Tim Cook
criticalAssertions.claim: Flat +2 AP on play at cost 5 — raw tempo spike, no condition.

criticalAssertions.name: Elon Musk
criticalAssertions.claim: Draw on play + once/turn AP on initiative; deckCost 8 is the main brake.

criticalAssertions.name: Whataboutism
criticalAssertions.claim: Reactivates a deactivated card for bp2 — undoes expensive removal at bargain rate.

criticalAssertions.name: Digitaler Wahlkampf
criticalAssertions.claim: Draws 1 per media/platform on board — scales with existing board, can be 3–4 cards.

criticalAssertions.name: Napoleon Komplex
criticalAssertions.claim: +1 to all T1 govs; strong in swarm decks but slot-limited (one Dauerhaft).

criticalAssertions.name: Symbolpolitik
criticalAssertions.claim: Draw 1 for bp1 with no other effect — filler by design, acceptable low floor.

criticalAssertions.name: Koalitionszwang
criticalAssertions.claim: Complex matching bonus + T2 synergy; can silently add several influence if boards mirror.

criticalAssertions.name: Tunnelvision
criticalAssertions.claim: Forces W6 probes on every government play for both players — high variance lockdown of the scoring lane.

criticalAssertions.name: Alternative Fakten
criticalAssertions.claim: Dampens enemy interventions by 1 — solid hate, not game-ending.

criticalAssertions.name: Scandal Spiral
criticalAssertions.claim: Cancels 2nd public; situational hate that rewards holding the trap.

criticalAssertions.name: T1 gov density pack
criticalAssertions.claim: Many T1 pols at I/BP ≥1.2 (e.g. 5I/4BP) outclass T2 prestige cards on efficiency.
